phase: Phase 4: Readers, week 1 (workbook pages and color A3 PDFs; 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-05)
summary: Adversarial pass for Phase 4. 12 new cases attack the Forge batch check, the picture CLI, and the final preflight. All 12 pass on the shipped code at 963cdfd8, and all 15 mutants are caught. No production defect found. Four low or info findings stay open as nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-P4-1 | severity: low | nonblocking | dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:389-391 | forgeManifestEntriesForRow selects a job with Array.find, so the first job with the row id wins. A manifest with two jobs of the same row id (for example a pending job, then a ready job) fails or passes the row by list order only, and no check reports the duplicate. The delivery contract gives job.id = row id, so one job for each row is the intent. Static finding; no test added, because no spec or plan rule names the duplicate case. Fix route: Green may throw on a duplicate row id, in a later chore.

ADV-P4-2 | severity: info | nonblocking | dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:477-494 | Confirms C-P4-12 by code reading: an absolute manifest path that points inside the batch root passes, because path.resolve keeps the absolute path and the root test accepts it. The contract allows files inside the root, so no safety defect. No test added. The doc comment at lines 466-468 says an absolute path fails its row; the code fails an absolute path outside the root only.

ADV-P4-3 | severity: low | nonblocking | dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:508-524 | Confirms A2-P4-1 by code reading: checkStorytimePictureBatch with an empty row list returns zero results and exitCode 0 (A4 vacuous pass). The CLI guards the case (check-storytime-pictures.ts:94-97, exit 1), so no present caller is affected. No test added: no spec or plan rule requires the library guard. Fix route: Green may throw on an empty list, in the Pictures task.

ADV-P4-4 | severity: info | nonblocking | dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:checkLine | A2-P4-7 is not a defect: FR-9 allows 8-bit grayscale line art, and the new cases use 8-bit gray files that pass. The check is not a 1-bit gate. C-P4-6 (the copy step from the Forge batch to the flat picture folder) is a plan item, not a code defect, and stays open for the Pictures task.
tests_by_area: A2-P4-3 symbolic links: ADV-P4-SYMLINK. A link to a valid file outside the root, a link to a folder outside the root, and a link to a sibling folder named batch-evil each fail their row with a link reason, and the clean row passes. ADV-P4-ROOT-LINK: a batch opened through a link to the batch folder passes. ADV-P4-SIBLING-PREFIX: a ../batch-evil path fails.

Delivery contract names: ADV-P4-OTHER-ROW-NAME (a job with the files of another row fails although the files are valid), ADV-P4-DECOY (the file at the manifest path is read, not a same-name file at the batch root or in another folder), ADV-P4-CONTROL (folder prefix passes).

Manifest shape: ADV-P4-MANIFEST-SHAPES. No jobs key, jobs as an object, an empty list, null, a number, and empty jobs each fail the row with a reason and exit 1; extra keys at manifest and job level pass.

Manifest facts: ADV-P4-TAMPER (a file changed after the SHA-256 fails; a wrong manifest pixel size fails). ADV-P4-IMAGE-FACTS (RGBA color file, color file in the line-art place, line art at 150 x 112 for a 200 x 150 row each fail with the matching reason).

A2-P4-6 final preflight: ADV-P4-A3-PREFLIGHT. The final --a3-color build with every line-art file present and one color file missing exits nonzero, names the color file, and creates no print-ready folder. ADV-P4-PICTURE-FILES: workbook lists 18 line-art names, A3 lists 18 color names, one reader lists 9.
CLI: ADV-P4-CLI-NO-MANIFEST. A batch folder without manifest.json exits 2 and names manifest.json, an unknown flag exits 2, and the batch folder gets no new file.
